name: minotaur-chopsticks-sim
description: anvil-compatible simulation shim over a Chopsticks fork of Bittensor subtensor (chain 964), for benchmarking Minotaur Apps that touch native staking/alpha/swap precompiles
comment: EXACT versions on purpose. This sidecar IS the chain-964 simulator, so its executor decides scores; two validators that built the image on different days must not run different runtime executors, and the lockfile is gitignored so the range would be the only pin. The range also bit us once already: chopsticks 1.5.1 made the PORT env var win over --port (cli.js), which the container sets — see chopsticks_rpc_server.mjs. Bump deliberately, re-run sn112_stake_poc.mjs, and promote fleet-uniform.
